issues.description: Sample rate not validated against supported STTAudioFormat literal
issues.detail: The constructor casts `f"pcm_{sample_rate}"` to STTAudioFormat without validation. Any sample_rate not in {8000,16000,22050,24000,44100,48000} (e.g. default-ish 48000 works but 32000 does not) will silently produce an invalid encoding string and the WebSocket will fail with an opaque server error. Validate and raise locally.

issues.description: Raising APIConnectionError from _process_stream_event does not propagate
issues.detail: `_process_stream_event` is called inside `recv_task` wrapped by `@utils.log_exceptions`, which swallows exceptions. Raising APIConnectionError on auth_error/quota_exceeded only logs and continues; the stream will not terminate or reconnect. Surface errors via the event channel or by closing the WS so the outer reconnect logic actually triggers.

issues.description: API key is sent as a query/header but logged paths may leak via ws_url construction
issues.detail: `ws_url` is built from base_url and params and `self._opts.api_key` is passed as a header (good), but any exception logging from `ws_connect` or upstream `log_exceptions` could include the URL. More importantly, no scheme validation: if base_url is http://, it becomes ws:// silently transmitting the API key over cleartext. Reject non-https base URLs or warn.

issues.description: STTModels Literal has a trailing comma making it a 1-tuple-ish single literal
issues.detail: `STTModels = Literal["scribe_v2_realtime",]` is syntactically a Literal of one value, which is fine, but the trailing comma is misleading and prevents easy extension review. More importantly, `model_id: STTModels` typed parameter rejects any future model string at type-check time; consider `str | STTModels` to allow forward compatibility like other plugins.

issues.description: Keepalive task pings before sleeping, producing immediate ping at connect
issues.detail: `keepalive_task` does `await ws.ping(); await asyncio.sleep(30)` in a loop, so it pings immediately on connect (harmless but unusual) and never handles ConnectionResetError explicitly; a swallowed exception just exits silently. Consider `sleep` first or log on exit so silent keepalive death is observable.

issues.description: language defaults to 'en' in SpeechData regardless of actual detection
issues.detail: `_process_stream_event` always sets `language=self._language or "en"` even if the user did not specify one and the server may have detected another language. Prefer passing through the server-provided language field if present in the payload, falling back to None or the configured language.

review.summary: The PR adds a clean WebSocket streaming STT v2 implementation following the established Deepgram/Cartesia pattern. Main concerns: sample_rate is cast to a Literal audio format without validation (silent failure for unsupported rates), error messages from the server raise inside a `log_exceptions`-wrapped task so auth/quota errors are swallowed instead of terminating the stream, and base_url scheme is not validated which could send the API key over ws:// in cleartext. Minor: STTModels Literal has a trailing comma and language is hardcoded to 'en' fallback. No tests added, but acknowledged in PR description.
